# CareHalo360

> Privacy-first home safety monitoring for families caring for an aging parent at home — no wearables, no constant watching, no recorded video.

CareHalo360 is a quiet, on-device safety monitoring service. It observes movement patterns to flag meaningful safety events (like falls or unusual inactivity) without recording video, using facial recognition, or requiring anything to be worn. Hardware is included in a single subscription ($79/mo public price), cancel anytime.
